findings.title: [P2] Resolve the output path before checking local_runs containment
findings.body: safe_path() checks the resolved location against WORK but returns the unnormalized absolute path. Consequently, an output such as work/geonet_clock_paired_independent_audit/local_runs/../report.json passes this lexical is_relative_to() check and is written outside local_runs. This violates the promised restriction to new ignored output files. Check containment using the resolved path after validating symlink ancestors.

findings.title: [P2] Check completed-slot status for original QML too
findings.body: The terminal-status check runs only in the fresh/native branch. slots_and_clocks() permits attempting, interrupted and not_attempted when their saved data and shadow clocks are null, so an original_qml slot with one of those statuses passes artifact replay and is merely counted as unavailable. A completed collection can therefore receive all_scoped_checks_pass=true despite an unfinished original representation. Apply the completion check to all eighteen slots; original slots should also be consistent with the already verified successful original retrieval.

overall_explanation: Static inspection found an output-directory containment bypass and a completion-validation gap for original QML slots. Review was limited to the five supplied members; no tests or actual-data reads were performed.
